historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the final working drawings for the bleachers at Silver Terrace Playground, designed by Charles F. Strothoff, Architect.

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for improvements to the playground and a field house here to Martinelli Construction Company at $121,950, after the low bidder, Elvin C. Stendell, showed he had made an honest error in his $109,985 bid.
Silver Terrace Playground, Silver Avenue near Bay Shore, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for concrete bleachers at Silver Terrace Playground to Antone Petersen & Sons at $143,647.

At the request of the Old Timers Baseball Association, the Recreation and Park Commission named a baseball diamond at Silver Terrace Playground for the late William "Pop" Edwards, long a figure in the city's amateur and semi-pro baseball, the plaque to be paid for by the baseball associations.
